utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Who’s handling the repair drive donations, and will Rey get the update on what gets finished first?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Jules is checking in on the pickup, Vik’s keeping everyone on the same plan, and Eli’s got the repair list. I’m not sure about the exact amount yet, though.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay, so Jules handles the donations and Rey gets the update once the first part is done, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, I’ll keep an ear out and let Rey know what gets finished first. The repair drive’s still Monday at the gym, and I’ll swing by later with the update.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Tess. I’ll let the crew know, and we’re keeping the repair drive focused on Maple and 3rd first.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds good, Rosa. I’ll keep Rey posted on what gets done first and what finishes later.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, I can help after school at 3:30. I’ll remind everyone about the cabinet hinges and the leaky sink under the hall bathroom.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, I’ll have the signup ready and check the parts tonight, then we’ll lock in who’s helping.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, 3:30 after school works for me. I’ll be there and keep an eye out for the signup.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ll keep the drive moving and sort the tools with Eli once he brings the list.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m keeping an eye out for the rest of the supplies, and the fund is still set aside for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ll keep things moving and sort the tools as the rest of the supplies come in.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll wait for Quinn or Sam to go through it one item at a time. Bo’s still on the repair drive, and Tess can let Rey know what got done first.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m mainly interested in which item the repair drive finishes first. Tess can let me know when it’s through.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: All right, then let Tess tell you which item finishes first.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can take a look and show you what’s wrong.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Who’s on supplies, and do we have enough hands once Nell gets here? I don’t want the repair drive to stall.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard Bo and Oren are already there, and I’m heading over to the repair drive now.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll spread the word and keep an eye out too. If anyone needs the drop-off spot, it’s Jules’s porch on Maple Street.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it, I’m heading over now.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ll go through the repair list with Mina one item at a time and keep it moving.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good, Sam. I’ve got the tools and a few extras, and I can walk through the repair list with you when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, I’ll keep it moving with Mina and make sure we stay on the list one item at a time.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm what time Hana should head over?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Have Hana head over when the repair drive starts; Bo’s already on it, and I’ll keep everyone lined up.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just confirm the start time with Hana, and I’ll make sure she knows when to head over.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: The money still goes to the fund. Hana needs the exact fix and a clear time estimate before she can say yes, and Dane can help keep things moving if we need it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, I can check with Sam and keep the repair list moving.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Good. Tess can keep Rey posted on what gets done first and what waits, so the list stays clear.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, I know Bo's still on the repair drive. The money's going to the fund, and Noah's still behind.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll keep nudging folks and make sure Jules checks in so the repair drive stays on track.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, I’ll keep an eye on it and make sure Bo stays in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I’m still on the repair drive. Leo can take a look, and I’ll let the others know about any donations.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Bo. I’ll keep checking in and make sure the donations keep getting to the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I’m still on it. I’ll keep the others posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can take a look at the repair drive and show you what’s wrong.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, then come look it over with Gus when he brings it by, and I’ll keep the signup ready and the parts list locked in tonight.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good, I’ll go over it with Gus when he brings it by.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, so Hana still wants the time confirmed before she heads over?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yes, Hana still wants the time confirmed before she heads over, right?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: It’s at 3:30 now, and I’m still most interested in what it gets through first.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, and Eli’s got the repair list, so that should tell us what gets done first.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Right, then I’m mostly watching to see what it gets through first.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, Monday at the gym’s still the plan, and I’ll swing by later to see what’s finished and let Rey know first.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: What still needs fixing on the repair drive? I just want to make sure it won’t run into school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Mostly the usual stuff still needs doing: porch and roof first, then the rest as they finish up. I’ll keep Rey posted on what gets done first and what wraps later.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Vik, you’ve really been keeping the repair drive moving. Glad Noah, Oren, and Bo are still there helping out.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I will keep nudging folks and make sure Jules checks in with the others so the repair drive keeps moving.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll keep checking in with the others so the repair drive keeps moving.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Bo still needs screws, a drill bit set, and maybe some wood glue for the repair drive. The money’s still going to the repair drive fund, and Noah still owes us those updates.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, Bo’s still on the repair drive, and the money’s going straight to the fund.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can walk through the repair list with Mina one item at a time and keep it moving.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sure, that should help keep it moving. I’m just trying to make sure Bo stays in the loop too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll keep an eye on Bo and make sure he stays with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ll keep the drive moving and sort the tools and supplies as we go.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll keep Bo with us and make sure the repair drive stays on track.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ve got it on Wednesday at the fire station, and I’ll keep Maple and 3rd at the top of the list with the porch and roof first. When Mara arrives with the tools, I’ll be ready.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m heading over too, and I heard Bo’s already there with Oren and Noah. Do you need me to check on supplies for Pia while I’m there?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, please check on supplies for Pia if you can, and let me know if anything’s running short.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m here for the repair drive too, Eli. I might be a bit scattered, but Bo’s on it and Ira can keep the list moving with Sam.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good. I’ll bring the list, and we can go through it one item at a time with Sam.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, one item at a time works for me. I’ll stay with you and help keep the list moving.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Who’s on supplies so we don’t stall once this starts? I’m still worried we’re light on hands and timing.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Quinn’s lining up the helpers and checking parts tonight, and I’ll make sure everyone remembers the hinges and that leaky sink under the hall bathroom.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good, but I still want to know who’s on supplies and when Quinn thinks we can start. I don’t want us short-handed when the drive kicks off.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll spread the word and ask around, and I know folks can drop donations at Jules’s porch on Maple Street for the repair drive.
